name: Behemoth
lore: Nothing on Meridia stops a Behemoth. It walks over what it cannot be bothered to walk round, and the ground remembers every step.

weapons.name: Hailstorm Rocket Pods
weapons.lore: Its third weapon: shoulder pods that ripple heavy unguided rockets up and over onto the mark, scattering wide and bursting big.

weapons.name: Tempest Rotary Cannon
weapons.lore: Six battleship barrels in a turning cluster, fired like a machine gun as each comes to the top; every spent casing is kicked clear and comes down like a girder.

weapons.name: AEB-3 Cataclysm Bore
weapons.lore: An electrical warhead on an arm: the strike raises a lightning storm that spreads for seconds and leaves nothing standing in it.

weapons.name: Heavy Twin Flak
weapons.lore: A twin flak turret beside each pod. Enough for a few gunships; against a real air wing the Behemoth wants escorts.
